title: Canonical inertia map and inertia comparison of a stack morphism
statement: For a functor $f:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ over a base scheme [def-pc-scheme] with the fibred-groupoid and 2-fibre-product conventions of [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids], the functor on inertia sends $(x,\alpha)$ to $(f(x),f(\alpha))$. The canonical inertia comparison $I_{\mathcal F/S}\to\mathcal F\times_{\mathcal G}I_{\mathcal G/S}$ sends $(x,\alpha)$ to $(x,f(x),\operatorname{id}_{f(x)})$ and sends an inertia arrow to its image together with the commuting square. It is a functor over the base.
